identity.name: ClockSync
identity.positioning: Frontier Tooling and Instrumentation for Digital Futures

operation.purpose: Apply a caller-supplied affine clock mapping while retaining the original timestamp and propagating joint timing uncertainty.

inputs.source_timestamp: seconds in an explicitly identified source clock frame
inputs.clock_model: caller-supplied positive-skew affine map with applicability interval

outputs.reference_timestamp: derived event coordinate in the declared reference frame
outputs.variance: first-order propagated variance in seconds squared

limits: Does not estimate a clock model.
Does not implement NTP, PTP, GNSS, UTC/TAI or leap-second conversion.
Does not set clocks, resample streams, authenticate evidence, admit state or actuate equipment.
First-order uncertainty propagation is not a guaranteed error bound or confidence interval.
